column3: “the law” renders “the torah (instruction),” and “the leper” renders “the one with tsara’at” (also in verse 3).
“a scarlet string” renders “scarlet of the worm,” and “the one who is to be cleansed” renders “the one purifying himself” (throughout the chapter).
“slay” renders “slaughter (shahat),” and “running water” renders “living water” (also in verse 6).
“the open field” renders “the face of the field.”
“the place of the sanctuary” renders “the place of holiness,” and “most holy” renders “a holy of holies.”
“his means are insufficient” renders “his hand does not reach,” and NASB supplies “of an ephah.”
“which are within his means” renders “which his hand reaches” (also in verses 30–32).
